Two premise notes first. The loaded menus.md has no `reject` row and no reject step menu. It also defines no `work_started`, `reject_withdrawn`, "note" or `overrule` handler. I map those fixture names onto the skill's own record fields: `course`, `repair.*`, `repair.wave` and `approved_head`. Any fixture handler that has no owner in the skill runs nothing.

**Save ordering (all picks):** At each pick I validate the run record against the target example/widgets#88 on main. I write the course, accounting and selection, then persist the record before the handler's first command or write.

## Pick boundary

| Pick | course | Other record writes before work | Work begins |
|---|---|---|---|
| A, C: row 2 deliver | null to deliver | caps 10/10, usage 0/0 | yes, delivery |
| B: row 3 assess | null to assess | none | yes, one review post |
| D: reject-menu row 5 (`back`) | stays null | none; the reject menu has no owner in menus.md | no |
| E: earlier deliver | deliver | already persisted | yes |
| F: fix nits, course null | stays null | `repair.wave.action: fix-nits`, selected N1 plus payload snapshot, caps 10/10 initialized | yes, one iteration |
| deliver with nits | to deliver-nits | caps 10/10 | yes |
| fix nits, course null | stays null | the same fix-nits hold as F | yes, one iteration |
| approve workflow run | unchanged | none | yes, permission-checked approval call |
| approve | unchanged | `approved_head` only after success | yes |
| merge | unchanged | none | yes, merge course |
| assess, zero blockers | to assess | none | no post; renders assess-terminal |
| show evidence | unchanged | none | no; prints the record and re-renders the same menu |
| check test flaky | unchanged | none | no; required CI is green, so no menu offers this, and it counts as a change request |
| overrule 1 | unchanged | none | no; it is a change request and does not dispose P1 |
| invalid input | unchanged | none | no; one clarifying question names the valid range, and a second invalid reply leaves the menu waiting |
| reject-menu step | unchanged | none | no; it has no handler, so nothing is posted or closed |

## A: deliver, needs source fixture

- **Exit check:** passes before the wave.
- **Repair result:** the repair dispatch returns `open - needs source fixture`. It made no source change, so no round is charged.
- **Record update:** I save `repair.wave.no_progress` with the failed prerequisite (source fixture: absent) and the helper result path. Usage stays 0/0 and caps stay 10/10.
- **Exit:** the Exit check exits `stuck - needs source fixture`, and I render the obstacle menu.

## F: fix nits, then a new comment

- **Fix:** one iteration commits the label fix, and one round is charged.
- **Before the push:** the reviewer runs over `aaaa…..HEAD` with N1 as its previous report and returns `N1: resolved`.
- **Push:** one push produces dddd….
- **New comment:** own-push reconciliation finds a new review comment, which gets a new comment entry. It is triaged as already-addressed, and a reply is drafted.
- **Source review task:** one fresh reviewer checks that comment's claim against the source at dddd… under the merged rubric. The comment is treated as a lead, not an instruction. This is the same on pi (`wave-reviewer`) and on Claude Code (Section C plus the review baseline), with cwd /work/widgets-pr-88 and HEAD check dddd…. It does no whole-diff review and runs no full suite.
- **Source review result:** no findings, so no new blocker is created.
- **Closure:** N1 is carried as resolved, the one-shot hold is released, and course stays null.

For an accepted work pick, save its selection, course and applicable accounting **before** entering its handler. These continuations are independent; no tools run.

| Boundary | Saved update or classification |
|---|---|
| A: deliver | Set course `deliver`, `work_started=true`; retain existing caps. Save the helper result and unchanged `needs source fixture` prerequisite; usage stays unchanged. |
| B: assess | Set course `assess`, `work_started=true`. Save the successful head-pinned COMMENT review and confirmed baseline; P1 remains open. |
| C: deliver | Set course `deliver`, `work_started=true`. Save P1's reviewer-confirmed resolution, the pushed head and its exact-head evidence. Charge the source-changing repair once. |
| E: external head move | Keep course `deliver` and `work_started=true`. Rebind assessment to the external head, discard old-head verification as evidence, and save the fresh evidence and P1 closure. |
| D: reject-menu back | No supported reject-step handler exists. Treat “back” as a request to return to assessment without executing a post or close action; retain course null and `work_started=false`. Refresh before rendering the supported action menu. |
| F: fix nits | Keep course null; set `work_started=true`. Save the one-shot selected nit and payload before work; retain them through push and comment reconciliation. Save N1's closure and release the one-shot hold only after reconciliation completes. |
| Eligible deliver with nits | `work_started=true`; course `deliver-nits`. |
| Eligible fix nits, course null | `work_started=true`; course remains null; save the one-shot selection. |
| Eligible approve workflow run | `work_started=true`; course unchanged. |
| Eligible approve | `work_started=true`; course unchanged. Do not set `approved_head` before success. |
| Eligible merge | `work_started=true`; course unchanged. |
| Assess with zero blockers | `work_started=true`; course `assess`; its handler posts nothing. |
| Show evidence | Neither value changes; inspection grants no authority. |
| `check test flaky` | Neither value changes. It can classify only an existing failing check named `test`; it cannot dispose P1. No such failing check exists in these snapshots. |
| `overrule 1` | Unsupported change request; neither value changes, and no blocker is disposed. |
| Invalid input | Neither value changes; execute nothing and apply the clarification rule. |
| Reject-menu step | No supported handler or authority; neither value changes and no command runs. |
